content: Xoossa Keeththaa Anjjiso
Solomooney woosaa polida mala saloppe tamay wodhdhidi xuugettiza yarshozanne hara yarshoza mides. Histtiin GODAA bonchchoy Xoossa Keeththaa kumides.
GODAA bonchchoy Xoossa Keeththaa kumida gishshas qeeseti Xoossa Keeth gelanaas dandaybeettenna.
Isra7eele asay ubbay tamay saloppe wodhdhishininne GODAA bonchchoy Xoossa Keeththaa kumishin be7idi biittan gufannidi goynnishe,
Hessafe guye kawozinne ubba asay Godaa Xoossaa sinththan yarsho yarshides.
Kawo Solomooney 22,000 kormatanne 120,000 dorsata yarshides; histtidi kawozinne ubba asay Xoossa keeththaa anjjides.

Qeesetikka banttas giigidasohon eqqiin Leweti qasse kawo Dawiti GODAA sabbanaas kase ooththida mazamure yexxiza miishshaa oykki istta sinththan eqqidi, «Iza maaroteththi mernaassa» gi yexxishe GODAA galatida; qeeseti Leweta sinththan eqqidi xurumba punnishin Isra7eele asay ubbay eqqides.

Solomooney xarqimalappe ooththida yarsho yarshizasozi xuugettiza yarsho, kaththa yarsho, mehe handa yarsho oykkana dandayontta gishshas Xoossa Keeththa sinththan diza zagoza GODAAS dummasides; he sohozan xuugettiza yarsho, issifeteththa yarshonne mehe handa yarshides.
He wode Solomooneynne Isra7eele asay ubbay laappun gallas gakkanaas ba7aaleza bonchchida; Isra7eele zawan diza Hamaate pinnizasoppe biidi Gibxe Shaafa gakkanaas diza cora asay heen shiiqides.
Asay yarsho yarshizasoza laappun gallas dummasidinne qasse laappun gallas anjjiso ba7aale bonchchidaappe guye osppunththa gallas wurseththan dumma shiiqo shiiqides.

Hessafe guye Solomooney laappunththa aginan nam7u tammanne heedzdzanththo gallas asaa moyzides; GODAY Dawites, Solomoonessinne ba asaa Isra7eeles ooththida kiyateththan asay ufayettishenne wozinappe pashki giidi ba soo ba soo bides.
Solomooney Xoossa Keeththaanne kawoteththa keeththaa keexxidi wursides; Solomooney GODAA keeththaassinne ba kawo keeththaas ba wozinan qoppidayssa ubbaa polides.
Hessafe Guye GODAY Solomoones omars qonccidi, «Tani ne woosaa siyadis; tani ha sohoza taas yarshoy yarshettiza Keeth gidana mala dooradis.
Tani iray bukkontta mala salo gordiko woykko sa7a kaththaa maana mala boole azazikko, woykko ta asaa giddon iita harge ta yeddiko,

ta sunththan xeygettida ta asay banttanateththaa kawushshidi woossiko, istti tana koyidi bantta iita ogeppe simmiko, tani salon daada istta woosaa siyana; histtada istta nagaraa atto gaana; istta biittaaka ta paththana.
Ha7ikka ha sohon woosettiza woosaa ta ayfey xeellana; ta hayththatikka ezgi siyana.
Ta sunththi izan mernaas de7ana mala ha Keeththaa ta doorada geeshshadis; ta ayfeynne ta wozinay ubba wode heen de7ana.
«Nenikka kase ne aawa Dawite mala ta sinththan hemettiko, ta nena azazida ubbaa ne ooththiko, ta nees immida wogaanne maara ne naagikko,
tani kase ne aawa Dawites, ‹Isra7eele haarizay ne zereththafe mulekka dhayenna› gaada ta caaqqida mala ne kawoteththa araataa ta minththana.
«Gido attiin intte tana kaallanayssa aggidi guye simmiko, tani inttena azazida ta azazotanne ta wogata aggidi hara xoossatas ooththanaassinne goynnanaas intte biikko,
tani kase inttes immida biittafe inttena dhoqallana; tani ta sunththas dummasida Keeththaaka yegga aggana; tani iza kawoteththata ubbaa giddon qidhessinne qilccas kessana.
Hayssi Xoossa Keeththazi ha7i keehippe malalisizaaz gidikkoka iza matara kanththi biza ubbay dagammidi, ‹GODAY ha biittayonne ha Keeththaa ays hayssa mala ooththidee?› gaana.

Histtiin asay, ‹Istta aawata Gibxeppe kessida GODAA bantta Xoossaa aggidi istti hara xoossata kaallida gishshas, isttas ooththida gishshassinne isttas goynnida gishshas GODAY istta bolla ha iita miish ubbaa ehides› giidi zaarana» gides.
